newsitem.title: USA: Albuquerque to issue $27.8 mln revenue bond.
newsitem.headline: Albuquerque to issue $27.8 mln revenue bond.

text.p: The City of Albuquerque will issue a $27.8 million revenue bond to finance a new communication complex for the city's police and fire departments, officials said on Friday.
Perry Baird, debt manager for the city, said the new complex will allow the departments to make speedier responses to emergencies.
He said the bond will be for four years and will be priced next week after negotiations with its managers, Smith Barney Inc., Merrill Lynch & Co., and Rauscher Pierce Refsnes Inc.
The issue will be a gross receipt tax adjustable tender revenue bond, which is payable from revenues received by the city from the state's gross receipts tax revenues.
Baird said the city has received a letter of credit from the German bank, Bayerische Landesbank Girozentrale to further secure the payment of the principal and interest.
